title: .to_string() on literals in test code (ws/mod.rs)
description: ws/mod.rs test section: lines 224, 297, 305-306, 321, 328-329, 331 use .to_string() on string literals where .to_owned() or String::from is the idiomatic form (clippy::str_to_string). These are in test code so no runtime cost impact, but they are inconsistent with the production code style and the clippy::str_to_string recommendation.
